verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a public REST API whose requests are authenticated with two headers (x-api-key and x-organization-id) using API keys that can be rotated. The reference covers endpoints for tax estimates, transaction sync, nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions and address suggestions. Five official SDKs are generated from the same OpenAPI spec, and an llms.txt file supports AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (every probed path returned 404, though the docs say the live spec is reachable via the MCP server).
